title: Waste by industry: the E-factor
caption: The E-factor is the mass of waste per mass of product. Oil refining makes very little waste per tonne; fine chemicals and pharmaceuticals can make 50 to over 100 kg of waste per kg, mostly solvents, because they use many steps. Upper ends of Sheldon's typical ranges.
alt: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of E-factor: oil refining 0.1, bulk chemicals 5, fine chemicals 50, pharmaceuticals 100.
yLabel: E-factor / kg waste per kg product (log scale)
